ja: チームリーダーの指摘をもっと早く聞いておけばよかった。そうすれば、発表の前にスライドを直せたのに。
en: I wish I'd listened to my team lead's feedback sooner, because then I could have fixed the slides before the presentation.
alternatives: If only I'd listened to my team lead's feedback earlier; I could have fixed the slides before the presentation.
I should've listened to my team lead's feedback sooner. Then I could've fixed the slides before the presentation.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish I had + 過去分詞

ja: 細かい直しはいくつか必要だけど、全体の構成はすごくいいと思うよ。
en: Although a few details need fixing, I think the overall structure is great.
alternatives: Even though some details need to be fixed, I think the overall structure is really good.
A few details need fixing, but I think the overall structure is great.
point: although を使ったら後ろに but を重ねない

ja: 先週いただいた指摘をもとに、スライドはもう全部直しました。
en: I've already fixed all the slides based on the feedback you gave me last week.
alternatives: Based on the feedback you gave me last week, I've already fixed all the slides.
I've already revised all the slides using the comments you gave me last week.
point: 直した結果は現在完了、last week の指摘は過去形で分ける

ja: 私のプレゼンについて、何かアドバイスをもらえますか？
en: Could you give me some advice on my presentation?
alternatives: Can you give me any advice about my presentation?
Do you have any advice for my presentation?
point: advice は数えられないので an advice や advices にしない

ja: この資料、すごくいいと思います。ただ、会議で見やすいように、グラフをもう少し大きくしてもらえないでしょうか。
en: I think this deck is really good, but I was wondering if you could make the charts a bit bigger so they're easier to see in the meeting.
alternatives: I think this deck is really good, but could you possibly make the charts a little bigger so they're easier to see in the meeting?
I think this deck is really good, though I wonder if you could make the charts a bit larger so they're easier to see in the meeting.
point: 柔らかい依頼は I was wondering if you could で

ja: 今回いただいた報告書は、内容が正確なだけでなく、構成も非常に分かりやすかったです。
en: Not only was your report accurate, but it was also remarkably easy to follow.
alternatives: Your report was not only accurate but also really easy to follow.
Your report wasn't just accurate; it was also very easy to follow.
point: Not only を文頭に出したら was your report と語順を倒す
